 Lovely Runner star Song Ji Ho marries singer-actress Kim So Ri
 Song Ji Ho played the brother of Kim Hye Yoon’s character in Lovely Runner. 
 by Khryzztine Joy Baylon 
 Published A day ago 
 Lovely Runner actor Song Ji Ho (left) marries singer-actress Kim So Ri (right) in an intimate ceremony attended by family and close friends in Seoul, South Korea. 
 PHOTO/S: @lovesori_ on Instagram 
 -->
 South Korean actor Song Ji Ho, known for his role in the hit drama Lovely Runner , has tied the knot with singer-actress Kim So Ri after years of dating. 
 On Instagram on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, Kim So Ri shared photos from their wedding ceremony, which was attended by family members and close friends. 
 In the photos, Kim So Ri was seen wearing a white gown, while her husband, Song Ji Ho, donned a classic black tuxedo. 
 Photo/s: @lovesori_ on Instagram 
 ADVERTISEMENT - CONTINUE READING BELOW ↓ 
 According to Kim So Ri, they exchanged vows on October 23 at Samcheonggak in Seoul, South Korea. 
 She captioned her post, “On October 23, 2026, we had a happy wedding surrounded by the blessings and well-wishes of so many people. We extend our heartfelt gratitude and love to everyone.” 
 Addressing her husband, the singer-actress wrote, “To Song Ji Ho, who is now my husband, thank you for waiting for me as my hair grew from a short bob to long hair, and for loving me so consistently. 
 “From now on, let’s continue to live happily and adorably together, laughing all the way until our black hair turns white. I love you.” 
 Song Ji Ho 
 Photo/s: @lovesori_ on Instagram 
 ADVERTISEMENT - CONTINUE READING BELOW ↓ 
 SONG JI HO, KIM SO RI'S RELATIONSHIP 
 Song Ji Ho and Kim So Ri announced their marriage plans on October 6 through handwritten letters shared with their fans. 
 In his letter, Song Ji Ho described Kim So Ri as someone with whom he could be his truest self and share his happiness. 
 He also recalled how they had supported each other through happy and difficult times as they grew together. 
 “I have found someone with whom I can truly be myself. Someone who makes me feel both at ease and happy—and with whom I want to share that happiness completely,” he wrote.

 Kim So Ri also reflected on finding the person she wanted to spend the rest of her life with. 
 “I have found someone who finds joy simply in being together and knows how to be grateful for even the smallest things—someone who makes life feel both beautiful and at ease,” she said.

 SONG JI HO, KIM SO RI'S CAREERS 
 Song Ji Ho made his acting debut in the 2013 film Friend: The Great Legacy . 
 He later appeared in several Korean television dramas, including Stranger (2017), Doctor Cha (2023), Lovely Runner (2024), and My Beloved Thief (2026). 
 In Lovely Runner , he played Im Geum, the older brother of Im Sol, portrayed by Kim Hye Yoon. 
 Meanwhile, Kim So Ri debuted as a singer in 2016 and was a member of the female duo CocoSori. She later participated in the project group Real Girls Project. 
 Kim So Ri has also appeared in the reality shows Somebody 2 and MIXNINE , as well as the drama The Idolmaster KR .
